gloss: how to handle; way of treating; manner of use
notes:
A versatile compound noun that can refer to handling physical objects (tools, machines), managing data or information, or treating people. Formed with the productive pattern of verb stem + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way of doing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧: to be good at handling
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to mishandle
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to know how to handle
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧: to handle roughly
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧: to be at a loss for how to deal with

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: how to use — specifically about operating or using something
- {対処法|たいしょほう}: coping method — focuses on dealing with problems or difficult situations
- ⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧: handling, treatment — a more formal synonym, often used in instructions and manuals

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧ (handling, from the verb ⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧) + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way, method).

definitions.gloss: how to handle; way of treating; manner of use
definitions.explanation: the method or manner of handling, treating, or dealing with something or someone
